functions.description: Parse base VPXA log structure: timestamp, host, pid, sub-component, opID, user, message
Extract source/destination IP address (IPv4 or bracketed IPv6) referenced in message
Extract destination port from message when present
Extract destination host for relocation/task target references
Classify severity and action based on message content
Convert ISO8601 timestamp string to epoch seconds for _time

add.name: log_time
add.value: log_time || generated_time || receive_time || start_time || event__created || timestamp || event__start

add.name: _time
add.value: (typeof log_time != 'undefined' && log_time) ? (/^\d{13}$/.test(String(log_time)) ? Number(log_time) : /^\d{10}$/.test(String(log_time)) ? Number(log_time) * 1000 : /^\d{13}\.\d+$/.test(String(log_time)) ? Number(log_time) : /^\d{10}\.\d+$/.test(String(log_time)) ? Number(log_time) * 1000 : new Date(String(log_time)).getTime()) / 1000 : _time
